title: Tell us about your business
lead: Eight questions. That is everything we need to put four designs in front of you.

questions.label: Who do you want to attract?
Pick three words for how your website should feel
questions.help: Pick from these or type your own.

questions.label: Do you already have a website or branding?
questions.help: A link is enough. If you have a logo or brand guide, there is a place to upload them after you have seen your designs.

questions.label: Anything you love or hate visually?
questions.help: Colors, other websites, anything you have seen that you liked or could not stand. Optional, and a rough answer is more use than none.
